description:
***Note: This work is depicted without sexual content and focuses on platonic love.***

One day, a god descends into the human world, wearing the shell of a man. Before him appears Noah, a troubled orphan who seems not quite in his right mind.

The god begins to journey with Noah, and in a world overflowing with ugliness and corruption, he feels something for the first time as he looks at Noah’s fragile innocence.

Noah, who has always run from people, carries a wish that is not so different from those of the corrupt humans around him. Yet this time, the god who has always ignored human wishes decides to grant Noah’s alone.

*“I want to go somewhere.”*  
*“All right.”*
